column1: # Bassignana, Mueller-Eberstein, Zhang, Plank. Evidence > Intuition: Transferability Estimation for
# Encoder Selection. EMNLP 2022, pp. 4218-4227. Appendix B, Table 2 (classification), read from
# arXiv 2210.11255 v1 on 2026-09-28. Performance in percent over 5 seeds (mean, sd); metric micro-F1,
# macro-F1 for SciERC. analysis/task4_gold_check.py verifies every row against the paper's own
# reported correlations; the sd columns cannot be checked that way. Known issues, both in the paper:
# RTE mean-pooled rows give Pearson 0.605 and 0.581 against the printed 0.616 and 0.597 (tau_w
# matches); the MNLI mean-pooled tuned sds of the last four models repeat SciERC's exactly.
